@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import errno
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl import get_sysctl, get_uptime_facts
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware import freebsd, netbsd, openbsd
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def module(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    return module
+
+
+def test_get_sysctl_mixed_lines_and_multiline_values(module):
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'hw.model = CPU\ninvalid\nhw.ncpu: 4\n'
+                                          'kern.text first line\n  second line\n\n'
+                                          'kern.boottime=123\n', '')
+
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw', 'kern']) == {
+        'hw.model': 'CPU', 'hw.ncpu': '4',
+        'kern.text': 'first line\n  second line\n', 'kern.boottime': '123',
+    }
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with(
+        'Unable to split sysctl line (invalid): not enough values to unpack (expected 2, got 1)')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('failure,warning', [
+    ((1, '', 'permission denied'), 'Unable to read sysctl: permission denied'),
+    (OSError('unavailable'), 'Unable to read sysctl: unavailable'),
+])
+def test_get_sysctl_command_failure(module, failure, warning):
+    if isinstance(failure, Exception):
+        module.run_command.side_effect = failure
+    else:
+        module.run_command.return_value = failure
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw']) == {}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with(warning)
+
+
+def test_get_sysctl_leading_continuation_warns_and_continues(module):
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, '  orphan\nhw.ncpu: 2\n', '')
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw']) == {'hw.ncpu': '2'}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to split sysctl line (  orphan): no preceding key')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('output,expected', [
+    ('100\n', {'uptime_seconds': 50}),
+    ('100.5\n', {'uptime_seconds': 49}),
+    ('', {}),
+    ('{ sec = 100, usec = 0 }', {}),
+    ('nan', {}),
+])
+def test_get_uptime_facts(module, mocker, output, expected):
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, output, '')
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl.time.time', return_value=150)
+    assert get_uptime_facts(module) == expected
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with(['/sbin/sysctl', '-n', 'kern.boottime'])
+
+
+def test_get_uptime_facts_nonzero_exit(module):
+    module.run_command.return_value = (1, '100', 'error')
+    assert get_uptime_facts(module) == {}
+
+
+def test_get_uptime_facts_missing_binary(module):
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_uptime_facts(module)
+
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.side_effect = OSError(errno.ENOENT, 'missing')
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_uptime_facts(module)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('hardware_class', [freebsd.FreeBSDHardware, netbsd.NetBSDHardware, openbsd.OpenBSDHardware])
+def test_bsd_hardware_populate_includes_uptime(module, mocker, hardware_class):
+    hardware = hardware_class(module)
+    for name in ('get_cpu_facts', 'get_processor_facts', 'get_memory_facts',
+                 'get_device_facts', 'get_dmi_facts', 'get_mount_facts'):
+        if hasattr(hardware, name):
+            mocker.patch.object(hardware, name, return_value={name: True})
+    mocker.patch.object(hardware, 'get_uptime_facts', return_value={'uptime_seconds': 50})
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, '', '')
+
+    result = hardware.populate()
+    assert result['uptime_seconds'] == 50
+    assert result['get_memory_facts'] is True
+    assert result['get_mount_facts'] is True
+    assert result['get_dmi_facts'] is True
+    if hardware_class is openbsd.OpenBSDHardware:
+        assert result['get_processor_facts'] is True
+        assert result['get_device_facts'] is True
+    elif hardware_class is freebsd.FreeBSDHardware:
+        assert result['get_cpu_facts'] is True
+        assert result['get_device_facts'] is True
+    else:
+        assert result['get_cpu_facts'] is True
